blocks.text: Use different records for generated language, trusted product facts, local review, approved intent, and execution results. GeneratedProposalContent can cite evidence IDs and suggest stages, but it has no permission or action fields. ProposalEnvelope joins that content with server-owned evidence and ActionEligibility without changing who owns either source.

blocks.title: Records and their source of truth
rows: A regenerated explanation cannot silently rewrite permissions or reviewed choices
Current account facts and permission revisions gate approval
Removing Cedar or overriding Acme remains visible even if evidence refreshes
One immutable command captures the exact reviewed records and expected versions
Only per-item results can confirm changed, conflicted, denied, or failed records

blocks.text: When evidence refreshes, compare each current version with ReviewState.reviewedEvidenceVersions. An untouched row can adopt the new evidence and eligibility. A row with a stage override remains selected but becomes review-required until the specialist inspects the change. If permission is lost, disable that row and explain the reason; do not delete it or reinterpret the generated proposal. This makes stale data visible while preserving the user's reasoning and the audit trail.
